simple.meaning: תַּנָּה (tannâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a female jackal.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּנָּה (H8568) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Lamentations 4:3, with occurrences in Lamentations, Malachi.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּנָּה (H8568) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּנָּה (H8568) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּנָּה (tannâh) / H8568 is traced through Lamentations 4:3, Malachi 1:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
